objs.name: document
objs.description: Document in the system that can be versioned, released, translated and distributed.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Individual user who can perform actions on Documents.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group of Users that can be assigned to documents for authorization.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system where a document visibility can be controlled.

objs.name: information_object
objs.description: Information Object that can be attached to a Document.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Attachment belonging to a Document; can be an Information Object or other attachments.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Additional information object that can be attached to a Document.

objs.name: equippments
objs.description: Equipments attached to a Document; have their own versioning.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of Users/Groups to receive distribution of a Document.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Creation of a new Document by a User.

evts.name: attach_information_object
evts.description: Attachment of a new Information Object to a Document.

evts.name: attach_additional_info
evts.description: Attachment of Additional Info to a Document.

evts.name: attach_equippments
evts.description: Attachment of Equippments to a Document.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Document release step in the workflow.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translation of a released Document into another language.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Extend the validity period of a Document.

evts.name: distribute_document
evts.description: Distribute a Document (e.g., by email) to Distribution List or Users.

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Sign the Document electronically as part of the workflow.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a Change Proposal for a Document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Complete a Change Proposal for a Document.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Publish a released Document to readers.

evts.name: create_version
evts.description: Create a new version of a Document.

evts.name: attach_information_object
evts.description: Attach Information Object to a Document.
